items.value: SLICE 1 — doctor's compare-target becomes origin/main, with merge-base semantics and a test harness. Section 2 of scripts/doctor.sh changes from `diff BP_COMMIT HEAD` to: fetch origin/main (section 1 already does), compute base=merge-base(BP_COMMIT, origin/main), and red when `git diff --name-only base origin/main -- '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd` is non-empty — i.e. the binary is stale iff origin/main contains Go-side changes the binary's ancestry lacks. Merge-base (not straight diff against origin/main) is load-bearing: a binary built from a worktree AHEAD with local Go changes must stay green (it contains MORE than main, not less). Unknown build commit AFTER the fetch reds-or-skips LOUDLY (never 'ok'); offline degrades to a visible skip. Because doctor.sh has now had two distinct false-green bugs in one week (regex #5935, this compare-target), the slice also lands scripts/doctor.test.sh in the pattern of install-cli.test.sh / fetch-prebuilt.test.sh: fake `bp` on PATH + fixture repo, driving the verdict matrix {binary at origin/main tip → green, behind → RED, ahead-with-local-Go → green, unknown commit → loud skip/red, no stamp → red, offline → visible skip}. The mutation proof becomes a permanent regression harness, wired into whatever CI job already runs the sibling shell tests.

SLICE 2 — the autoseed tripwire: a dedicated advisory workflow (scaffy-catalog-drift.yml or similar) + `make seed-check`. Triggers: push to main touching scaffy/commands/**, scaffy/seed/**, internal/scaffy/**; a daily cron (drift can also arise server-side); and workflow_dispatch for manual re-audit. The job is TOKENLESS (no guerrilla creds in CI — hard constraint) and ADVISORY (continue-on-error / non-required): it surfaces drift with the seed --check table in the job summary, it never gates merges, because the remediation (re-seed the served catalog) is a human/lead ops action, not a CI mutation. Mutation proof: locally mutate one .scaffy corpus file → seed --check must exit 1 with exactly that drift row; unmutated → 22/22 green; plus one green workflow_dispatch run on main.

items.value: RIVAL A — minimal patch: swap HEAD for origin/main in the diff line; bolt seed --check onto go-tests.yml. Cheapest, but it repeats the exact pattern that produced this wave: doctor.sh got a point-fix (#5935) yesterday and false-greened again today by a different route. A one-line target swap also gets the AHEAD case wrong (a binary containing unpushed local Go changes would red falsely) — the semantics need merge-base, and semantics without a test harness are the next regression. Bolting onto go-tests.yml couples an advisory network-dependent check to a REQUIRED gate's workflow, muddying the gate story. Rejected.

RIVAL B — subsume it all into `bp doctor` (Go): fold checkout-side freshness into the binary's own doctor receipt (the onboarding-doctor lineage). Structurally elegant long-term, but self-defeating here: a STALE binary would be running the staleness check on itself — the checkout must audit the binary, not the binary itself. Also 5-10x the scope, crosses into the onboarding epic's lane, and forecloses nothing if done later: the shell fix + test harness transplant cleanly. Rejected for this wave, left open for the onboarding epic.

WINNER — fix-in-place with correct merge-base semantics + a permanent shell test harness, and a dedicated advisory drift workflow. It fixes the actual reported failure, makes a third doctor regression structurally harder (harness), keeps advisory and required gates cleanly separated, and stays inside the throughput fence.

SHARPEST ATTACK on the winner: the verdict-matrix semantics could still be wrong in an edge (worktree-shared refs, unknown-commit-after-fetch, or the Go-input path set '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd missing an embedded-asset input like internal/cli/setup/assets), producing a new false verdict with higher confidence than before. ABSORBED: this is exactly the uncertainty-gated verify target — the flip-prone call ('does a legit up-to-date binary stay green, does an ahead binary stay green') gets a dedicated verifier who runs the matrix on real fixture repos before any builder merges; the path-set truth is a standing survey question. items.value: SLICE 1 — doctor's compare-target becomes origin/main, with merge-base semantics and a test harness. The wish

CLI-RELIABILITY throughput wave (scoreboard-parent task-09f4775e7ccc2cca): fix the two freshly-verified non-Elixir bugs from the scaffy-D58 wave. (1) doctor.sh FALSE-GREENS on bp-binary staleness — it diffs the installed binary's build commit against LOCAL HEAD, not origin/main, so a stale binary built from a diverged worktree reports healthy while missing merged CLI changes. (2) AUTOSEED GAP — no CI check runs `go run ./scaffy/seed --check`, so the served scaffy catalog silently drifts from main after corpus merges. Non-Elixir fence: internal/cli + scripts + CI yaml, merging on the Go/CI gate. Mutation-prove each fix; honest count; improvement-only.

Premise smoke (run at Strategize, on origin/main)

Both premises were git-shown and ledger-checked on origin/main BEFORE any direction was set. Result: both bugs survive smoke in substance, but both citations needed correction — exactly the stale-premise class this guard exists for.

1. BUG 1 CONFIRMED, CITATION CORRECTED. The wish cites pdf-bl-doctor-bp-staleness-regex — that task is CLOSED (PR #5935 merged 2026-07-23, commit 0f2497d55): it fixed a DIFFERENT bug (the dirty-suffix commit-parse regex). The wish's actual bug — `git diff --name-only "$BP_COMMIT" HEAD -- '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd` compares against LOCAL HEAD — is verbatim present on origin/main in scripts/doctor.sh section 2, unfixed. The LIVE ledger anchor is the OPEN, unclaimed task scaffy-backlog-doctor-bp-freshness, which reproduces the false-green (272-behind/18-ahead worktree, binary from that same worktree greens) and adds a second soundness finding: Go -buildvcs stamps are untrustworthy in this repo layout (nested-worktree ancestor-.git trap, reproduced 3 ways) — the ldflags-embedded `bp version` commit field is the only trustworthy signal.
2. BUG 2 HALF-STALE, STRUCTURAL GAP CONFIRMED. The wish's claim 'seed --check IS red right now' was refuted at 13:56Z today: task scaffy-dr-catalog-reseed re-seeded both drifted ids (block-type--starter, oban-worker--cron) and recorded 22/22 MATCH green-after. But the STRUCTURAL bug stands: zero .github/workflows files reference scaffy/seed (grepped on origin/main across all 34 workflows) — the catalog only got fixed because a wave happened to look. seed --check is tokenless by design (reads the PUBLISHED perspective from guerrilla.barkpark.cloud, const defaultServer in scaffy/seed/main.go), fails loud on network error, and measured 0.27s warm — ideal for an advisory CI tripwire.
3. Collision scan: none of the 15 open PRs touch scripts/doctor.sh, .github/workflows/*, or scaffy/seed. Fence is clear at Strategize time.

Direction

An honest TWO-slice wave, each slice a permanent instrument rather than a patch.

1. SLICE 1 — doctor's compare-target becomes origin/main, with merge-base semantics and a test harness. Section 2 of scripts/doctor.sh changes from `diff BP_COMMIT HEAD` to: fetch origin/main (section 1 already does), compute base=merge-base(BP_COMMIT, origin/main), and red when `git diff --name-only base origin/main -- '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd` is non-empty — i.e. the binary is stale iff origin/main contains Go-side changes the binary's ancestry lacks. Merge-base (not straight diff against origin/main) is load-bearing: a binary built from a worktree AHEAD with local Go changes must stay green (it contains MORE than main, not less). Unknown build commit AFTER the fetch reds-or-skips LOUDLY (never 'ok'); offline degrades to a visible skip. Because doctor.sh has now had two distinct false-green bugs in one week (regex #5935, this compare-target), the slice also lands scripts/doctor.test.sh in the pattern of install-cli.test.sh / fetch-prebuilt.test.sh: fake `bp` on PATH + fixture repo, driving the verdict matrix {binary at origin/main tip → green, behind → RED, ahead-with-local-Go → green, unknown commit → loud skip/red, no stamp → red, offline → visible skip}. The mutation proof becomes a permanent regression harness, wired into whatever CI job already runs the sibling shell tests.
2. SLICE 2 — the autoseed tripwire: a dedicated advisory workflow (scaffy-catalog-drift.yml or similar) + `make seed-check`. Triggers: push to main touching scaffy/commands/**, scaffy/seed/**, internal/scaffy/**; a daily cron (drift can also arise server-side); and workflow_dispatch for manual re-audit. The job is TOKENLESS (no guerrilla creds in CI — hard constraint) and ADVISORY (continue-on-error / non-required): it surfaces drift with the seed --check table in the job summary, it never gates merges, because the remediation (re-seed the served catalog) is a human/lead ops action, not a CI mutation. Mutation proof: locally mutate one .scaffy corpus file → seed --check must exit 1 with exactly that drift row; unmutated → 22/22 green; plus one green workflow_dispatch run on main.

Ledger hygiene: slice 1 claims and drives the already-open scaffy-backlog-doctor-bp-freshness task (perfected to this wave's shape) rather than filing a duplicate. The refuted 'red right now' claim is recorded honestly here — the deliverable for bug 2 is the tripwire, not the re-seed (already done). Fence: internal/cli + scripts/ + .github/workflows + scaffy/seed read-only; NO corpus files added (census trap); NO api/lib.

Direction debate

• RIVAL A — minimal patch: swap HEAD for origin/main in the diff line; bolt seed --check onto go-tests.yml. Cheapest, but it repeats the exact pattern that produced this wave: doctor.sh got a point-fix (#5935) yesterday and false-greened again today by a different route. A one-line target swap also gets the AHEAD case wrong (a binary containing unpushed local Go changes would red falsely) — the semantics need merge-base, and semantics without a test harness are the next regression. Bolting onto go-tests.yml couples an advisory network-dependent check to a REQUIRED gate's workflow, muddying the gate story. Rejected.
• RIVAL B — subsume it all into `bp doctor` (Go): fold checkout-side freshness into the binary's own doctor receipt (the onboarding-doctor lineage). Structurally elegant long-term, but self-defeating here: a STALE binary would be running the staleness check on itself — the checkout must audit the binary, not the binary itself. Also 5-10x the scope, crosses into the onboarding epic's lane, and forecloses nothing if done later: the shell fix + test harness transplant cleanly. Rejected for this wave, left open for the onboarding epic.
• WINNER — fix-in-place with correct merge-base semantics + a permanent shell test harness, and a dedicated advisory drift workflow. It fixes the actual reported failure, makes a third doctor regression structurally harder (harness), keeps advisory and required gates cleanly separated, and stays inside the throughput fence.
• SHARPEST ATTACK on the winner: the verdict-matrix semantics could still be wrong in an edge (worktree-shared refs, unknown-commit-after-fetch, or the Go-input path set '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd missing an embedded-asset input like internal/cli/setup/assets), producing a new false verdict with higher confidence than before. ABSORBED: this is exactly the uncertainty-gated verify target — the flip-prone call ('does a legit up-to-date binary stay green, does an ahead binary stay green') gets a dedicated verifier who runs the matrix on real fixture repos before any builder merges; the path-set truth is a standing survey question. Secondary attack: an advisory CI job that reds on transient network noise trains everyone to ignore it — absorbed by keeping fail-loud semantics but advisory status, daily cron (not per-PR spam), and the drift table in the job summary so a red is one glance to triage.

Survey plan (in flight)

15 Sonnet surveyors are flying now. Questions, verbatim, with why each matters:

1. doctor-semantics-matrix — enumerate section-2 verdicts on origin/main under {behind, ahead, diverged, unknown-commit, offline, dirty-stamp, no-stamp} and check merge-base(BP_COMMIT, origin/main)→origin/main diff yields the correct verdict in each. WHY: this is the flip-prone core; wrong semantics here is a worse bug than the one we fix.
2. go-input-path-truth — is '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd the TRUE input set of the bp binary (embedded assets, vendored deploy.sh, scaffy corpus embeds, Makefile LDFLAGS inputs)? WHY: a correct compare-target over the wrong path set still false-greens.
3. doctor-consumers — who consumes doctor.sh output (SessionStart hook, make doctor, local-update.sh, any parser of its lines / exit-0 contract)? WHY: changed messages or exit behavior must not break hooks.
4. shell-test-precedent — how install-cli.test.sh / fetch-prebuilt.test.sh are structured and WHICH workflow runs them; can doctor.test.sh ride the same job? WHY: slice 1's harness should join an existing lane, not invent one.
5. worktree-ref-nuances — in linked worktrees, do origin/main refs + fetched objects behave identically (shared .git), and can BP_COMMIT objects be missing per-worktree? WHY: the false-green was observed IN a worktree; the fix must be worktree-correct.
6. buildvcs-doctrine-verify — re-derive the D58 paper's claim that go-version -m vcs stamps are unsound and that the ldflags 'commit' JSON key is stable across recent bp releases. WHY: the fix trusts that key exclusively.
7. makefile-update-parity — does make update / local-update.sh rebuild bp when doctor reds it (gauge↔fixer parity)? WHY: a red that make update doesn't fix breaks the doctor contract ('make update is the fixer').
8. ci-advisory-conventions — precedents in .github/workflows for advisory jobs (continue-on-error usage), cron, path filters, concurrency groups, never-cancel-main-check interactions. WHY: slice 2 must match house style and not trip meta-gates.
9. seed-check-runtime — what seed --check needs in CI (Go toolchain version, egress to guerrilla.barkpark.cloud from GitHub runners, behavior on 5xx/timeout, actual runtime). WHY: an advisory job that can't run is decoration.
10. scaffy-census-trap — does a workflow triggered on scaffy/** interact with the corpus-count census guard; confirm read-only usage trips nothing. WHY: known trap class from the scaffy epic.
11. drift-classes — beyond edit-without-reseed: does --check catch EXTRA served docs, MISSING, server-side edits? What does the table show per class? WHY: shapes the job summary and the mutation proof.
12. open-task-dedup — full ledger scan for open doctor/freshness/seed-check tasks (scaffy-backlog-doctor-bp-freshness, scaffy-backlog-validate-repo-ci-gate, onb-* doctor tasks): which to claim/perfect vs link vs leave. WHY: no duplicate filing; claim-and-drive beats file-new.
13. required-gate-map — which CI gates are REQUIRED for a scripts+workflows+Go-adjacent PR; confirm it merges parallel to the Elixir queue; any workflow-file push-permission constraints. WHY: throughput promise depends on the non-Elixir merge lane being real.
14. collision-watch — re-scan open PRs/branches + active-session claims touching doctor.sh, workflows, scaffy/seed. WHY: 40+ concurrent agents; the Strategize-time clear can rot in hours.
15. doctor-history — git log of scripts/doctor.sh (last ~15 commits): what shapes did prior fixes take, any reverted approach we would re-walk? WHY: two regressions in a week says the file has a history worth reading before a third edit.

Wave status

The wish

CLI-RELIABILITY throughput wave (scoreboard-parent task-09f4775e7ccc2cca): fix the two freshly-verified non-Elixir bugs from the scaffy-D58 wave. (1) doctor.sh FALSE-GREENS on bp-binary staleness — it diffs the installed binary's build commit against LOCAL HEAD, not origin/main, so a stale binary built from a diverged worktree reports healthy while missing merged CLI changes. (2) AUTOSEED GAP — no CI check runs `go run ./scaffy/seed --check`, so the served scaffy catalog silently drifts from main after corpus merges. Non-Elixir fence: internal/cli + scripts + CI yaml, merging on the Go/CI gate. Mutation-prove each fix; honest count; improvement-only.

Premise smoke (run at Strategize, on origin/main)

Both premises were git-shown and ledger-checked on origin/main BEFORE any direction was set. Result: both bugs survive smoke in substance, but both citations needed correction — exactly the stale-premise class this guard exists for.

  1. BUG 1 CONFIRMED, CITATION CORRECTED. The wish cites pdf-bl-doctor-bp-staleness-regex — that task is CLOSED (PR #5935 merged 2026-07-23, commit 0f2497d55): it fixed a DIFFERENT bug (the dirty-suffix commit-parse regex). The wish's actual bug — `git diff --name-only "$BP_COMMIT" HEAD -- '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd` compares against LOCAL HEAD — is verbatim present on origin/main in scripts/doctor.sh section 2, unfixed. The LIVE ledger anchor is the OPEN, unclaimed task scaffy-backlog-doctor-bp-freshness, which reproduces the false-green (272-behind/18-ahead worktree, binary from that same worktree greens) and adds a second soundness finding: Go -buildvcs stamps are untrustworthy in this repo layout (nested-worktree ancestor-.git trap, reproduced 3 ways) — the ldflags-embedded `bp version` commit field is the only trustworthy signal.
  2. BUG 2 HALF-STALE, STRUCTURAL GAP CONFIRMED. The wish's claim 'seed --check IS red right now' was refuted at 13:56Z today: task scaffy-dr-catalog-reseed re-seeded both drifted ids (block-type--starter, oban-worker--cron) and recorded 22/22 MATCH green-after. But the STRUCTURAL bug stands: zero .github/workflows files reference scaffy/seed (grepped on origin/main across all 34 workflows) — the catalog only got fixed because a wave happened to look. seed --check is tokenless by design (reads the PUBLISHED perspective from guerrilla.barkpark.cloud, const defaultServer in scaffy/seed/main.go), fails loud on network error, and measured 0.27s warm — ideal for an advisory CI tripwire.
  3. Collision scan: none of the 15 open PRs touch scripts/doctor.sh, .github/workflows/*, or scaffy/seed. Fence is clear at Strategize time.

Direction

An honest TWO-slice wave, each slice a permanent instrument rather than a patch.

  1. SLICE 1 — doctor's compare-target becomes origin/main, with merge-base semantics and a test harness. Section 2 of scripts/doctor.sh changes from `diff BP_COMMIT HEAD` to: fetch origin/main (section 1 already does), compute base=merge-base(BP_COMMIT, origin/main), and red when `git diff --name-only base origin/main -- '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd` is non-empty — i.e. the binary is stale iff origin/main contains Go-side changes the binary's ancestry lacks. Merge-base (not straight diff against origin/main) is load-bearing: a binary built from a worktree AHEAD with local Go changes must stay green (it contains MORE than main, not less). Unknown build commit AFTER the fetch reds-or-skips LOUDLY (never 'ok'); offline degrades to a visible skip. Because doctor.sh has now had two distinct false-green bugs in one week (regex #5935, this compare-target), the slice also lands scripts/doctor.test.sh in the pattern of install-cli.test.sh / fetch-prebuilt.test.sh: fake `bp` on PATH + fixture repo, driving the verdict matrix {binary at origin/main tip → green, behind → RED, ahead-with-local-Go → green, unknown commit → loud skip/red, no stamp → red, offline → visible skip}. The mutation proof becomes a permanent regression harness, wired into whatever CI job already runs the sibling shell tests.
  2. SLICE 2 — the autoseed tripwire: a dedicated advisory workflow (scaffy-catalog-drift.yml or similar) + `make seed-check`. Triggers: push to main touching scaffy/commands/**, scaffy/seed/**, internal/scaffy/**; a daily cron (drift can also arise server-side); and workflow_dispatch for manual re-audit. The job is TOKENLESS (no guerrilla creds in CI — hard constraint) and ADVISORY (continue-on-error / non-required): it surfaces drift with the seed --check table in the job summary, it never gates merges, because the remediation (re-seed the served catalog) is a human/lead ops action, not a CI mutation. Mutation proof: locally mutate one .scaffy corpus file → seed --check must exit 1 with exactly that drift row; unmutated → 22/22 green; plus one green workflow_dispatch run on main.

Ledger hygiene: slice 1 claims and drives the already-open scaffy-backlog-doctor-bp-freshness task (perfected to this wave's shape) rather than filing a duplicate. The refuted 'red right now' claim is recorded honestly here — the deliverable for bug 2 is the tripwire, not the re-seed (already done). Fence: internal/cli + scripts/ + .github/workflows + scaffy/seed read-only; NO corpus files added (census trap); NO api/lib.

Direction debate

  • RIVAL A — minimal patch: swap HEAD for origin/main in the diff line; bolt seed --check onto go-tests.yml. Cheapest, but it repeats the exact pattern that produced this wave: doctor.sh got a point-fix (#5935) yesterday and false-greened again today by a different route. A one-line target swap also gets the AHEAD case wrong (a binary containing unpushed local Go changes would red falsely) — the semantics need merge-base, and semantics without a test harness are the next regression. Bolting onto go-tests.yml couples an advisory network-dependent check to a REQUIRED gate's workflow, muddying the gate story. Rejected.
  • RIVAL B — subsume it all into `bp doctor` (Go): fold checkout-side freshness into the binary's own doctor receipt (the onboarding-doctor lineage). Structurally elegant long-term, but self-defeating here: a STALE binary would be running the staleness check on itself — the checkout must audit the binary, not the binary itself. Also 5-10x the scope, crosses into the onboarding epic's lane, and forecloses nothing if done later: the shell fix + test harness transplant cleanly. Rejected for this wave, left open for the onboarding epic.
  • WINNER — fix-in-place with correct merge-base semantics + a permanent shell test harness, and a dedicated advisory drift workflow. It fixes the actual reported failure, makes a third doctor regression structurally harder (harness), keeps advisory and required gates cleanly separated, and stays inside the throughput fence.
  • SHARPEST ATTACK on the winner: the verdict-matrix semantics could still be wrong in an edge (worktree-shared refs, unknown-commit-after-fetch, or the Go-input path set '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd missing an embedded-asset input like internal/cli/setup/assets), producing a new false verdict with higher confidence than before. ABSORBED: this is exactly the uncertainty-gated verify target — the flip-prone call ('does a legit up-to-date binary stay green, does an ahead binary stay green') gets a dedicated verifier who runs the matrix on real fixture repos before any builder merges; the path-set truth is a standing survey question. Secondary attack: an advisory CI job that reds on transient network noise trains everyone to ignore it — absorbed by keeping fail-loud semantics but advisory status, daily cron (not per-PR spam), and the drift table in the job summary so a red is one glance to triage.

Survey plan (in flight)

15 Sonnet surveyors are flying now. Questions, verbatim, with why each matters:

  1. doctor-semantics-matrix — enumerate section-2 verdicts on origin/main under {behind, ahead, diverged, unknown-commit, offline, dirty-stamp, no-stamp} and check merge-base(BP_COMMIT, origin/main)→origin/main diff yields the correct verdict in each. WHY: this is the flip-prone core; wrong semantics here is a worse bug than the one we fix.
  2. go-input-path-truth — is '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd the TRUE input set of the bp binary (embedded assets, vendored deploy.sh, scaffy corpus embeds, Makefile LDFLAGS inputs)? WHY: a correct compare-target over the wrong path set still false-greens.
  3. doctor-consumers — who consumes doctor.sh output (SessionStart hook, make doctor, local-update.sh, any parser of its lines / exit-0 contract)? WHY: changed messages or exit behavior must not break hooks.
  4. shell-test-precedent — how install-cli.test.sh / fetch-prebuilt.test.sh are structured and WHICH workflow runs them; can doctor.test.sh ride the same job? WHY: slice 1's harness should join an existing lane, not invent one.
  5. worktree-ref-nuances — in linked worktrees, do origin/main refs + fetched objects behave identically (shared .git), and can BP_COMMIT objects be missing per-worktree? WHY: the false-green was observed IN a worktree; the fix must be worktree-correct.
  6. buildvcs-doctrine-verify — re-derive the D58 paper's claim that go-version -m vcs stamps are unsound and that the ldflags 'commit' JSON key is stable across recent bp releases. WHY: the fix trusts that key exclusively.
  7. makefile-update-parity — does make update / local-update.sh rebuild bp when doctor reds it (gauge↔fixer parity)? WHY: a red that make update doesn't fix breaks the doctor contract ('make update is the fixer').
  8. ci-advisory-conventions — precedents in .github/workflows for advisory jobs (continue-on-error usage), cron, path filters, concurrency groups, never-cancel-main-check interactions. WHY: slice 2 must match house style and not trip meta-gates.
  9. seed-check-runtime — what seed --check needs in CI (Go toolchain version, egress to guerrilla.barkpark.cloud from GitHub runners, behavior on 5xx/timeout, actual runtime). WHY: an advisory job that can't run is decoration.
  10. scaffy-census-trap — does a workflow triggered on scaffy/** interact with the corpus-count census guard; confirm read-only usage trips nothing. WHY: known trap class from the scaffy epic.
  11. drift-classes — beyond edit-without-reseed: does --check catch EXTRA served docs, MISSING, server-side edits? What does the table show per class? WHY: shapes the job summary and the mutation proof.
  12. open-task-dedup — full ledger scan for open doctor/freshness/seed-check tasks (scaffy-backlog-doctor-bp-freshness, scaffy-backlog-validate-repo-ci-gate, onb-* doctor tasks): which to claim/perfect vs link vs leave. WHY: no duplicate filing; claim-and-drive beats file-new.
  13. required-gate-map — which CI gates are REQUIRED for a scripts+workflows+Go-adjacent PR; confirm it merges parallel to the Elixir queue; any workflow-file push-permission constraints. WHY: throughput promise depends on the non-Elixir merge lane being real.
  14. collision-watch — re-scan open PRs/branches + active-session claims touching doctor.sh, workflows, scaffy/seed. WHY: 40+ concurrent agents; the Strategize-time clear can rot in hours.
  15. doctor-history — git log of scripts/doctor.sh (last ~15 commits): what shapes did prior fixes take, any reverted approach we would re-walk? WHY: two regressions in a week says the file has a history worth reading before a third edit.

Wave status

Wave status: COMPLETE Reviewed + debriefed 2026-07-23. 2/2 slices green, both pushed + PR (slice 1 #6023 no fixes; slice 2 #6025 with one reviewer fix), grade A-. Lead merges; D10 post-merge obligations open. Full story in the Debrief section below.

Survey digest (Digest phase — 15 reports in)

Both bugs confirmed live on origin/main at digest time (re-smoked fresh): doctor.sh line 95 diffs BP_COMMIT against LOCAL HEAD, and no CI workflow anywhere invokes scaffy/seed or seed --check. The merge-base topology (red iff origin/main carries Go changes the binary's ancestry lacks) was case-analyzed and empirically checked: at-tip green, behind-only RED, ahead-with-local-Go green (merge-base==origin/main, empty diff — the load-bearing reason a bare origin/main swap is wrong), diverged RED. ONE real gap in the proposed one-liner: it carries no fetch-success/ref-existence guard of its own — offline or missing origin/main ref makes command substitution swallow the git error, $base goes empty, and the check reads GREEN (silent false-ok exactly where a loud skip is required). The fix must wrap the diff in git rev-parse --verify --quiet origin/main + a fetch gate, and keep the existing cat-file unknown-commit gate ORDERED BEFORE the merge-base call.

  • Path set '*.go' go.mod go.sum internal cmd is the true bp build-input closure (zero go:embed in cmd/barkpark; provisioner templates belong to a different binary); one contingency: root deploy.sh is a real input protected only by vendored-assets.yml — add 'deploy.sh' to the pathspec as one-word defense-in-depth (drift history #757/#499 is real).
  • Consumers safe: SessionStart hook (sole reader, raw text) needs new branches routed through bad()/skip() (never raw printf) and the unconditional exit 0 kept — upgrade_test.go asserts exit 0 and its fake-git falls through on unknown subcommands (merge-base) — interplay must be RUN, not assumed.
  • Worktree refs/objects fully shared via commondir — no per-worktree compensation needed; but the fix must use explicit refs (BP_COMMIT, origin/main), never anything HEAD/main-relative.
  • buildvcs unsoundness independently re-reproduced (nested worktree stamps the PRIMARY checkout's HEAD); ldflags 'commit' JSON key is stable since introduction and is already what doctor.sh reads — only the compare-target is wrong.
  • seed --check is genuinely tokenless (reads only config 'server' key — proven by code read + DNS-failure mutation: exit 1, loud), sub-2s, 4 statuses (MATCH/DRIFT/MISSING/EXTRA) all aggregated to exit 1; currently 22/22 green after today's re-seed — the deliverable is the tripwire, not a re-seed. Latent: unpaginated limit=100; network failure prints NO table (red without rows must read as 'unreachable', not drift).
  • CI conventions settled: job-level continue-on-error:true + ADVISORY header; concurrency cancel-in-progress MUST be false or the ref-expression (literal true reds never-cancel-main-check via doc-gates.yml's .github/workflows/** glob); astro-finder-drift.yml is the near-template; daily-cron precedent exists (paper-readers.yml); gh token already has workflow scope.
  • Ledger: slice 1 claims scaffy-backlog-doctor-bp-freshness, slice 2 claims scaffy-backlog-seedcheck-ci-advisory (open, unclaimed, re-verified twice; the second was NOT in the wish but is the correct existing anchor — no new task gets filed). Collision scan clean: no open PR or live branch touches the fence; residual soft risk: agent 'cli-install-builder' name adjacency, unresolved.

Premise corrections (recorded honestly)

Its stale-read conclusions are discarded; its line-anchored local-update.sh finding stands: make update early-exits (OLD==NEW) without ever checking bp's own commit, so 'make update' cannot refresh a stale bp when the checkout is already current — a residual for a backlog task, softened because the actual stale-bp hint is cli-install (rebuilds unconditionally). Remaining wrinkle: cli-install from a BEHIND checkout rebuilds a still-behind binary; the hint may want to chain 'make update && make cli-install'.

Two real wiring options: (A) sibling doctor.test.sh + net-new paths-scoped workflow (deploy-harnesses.yml precedent), or (B) a --selftest flag in doctor.sh riding an astro-finder-drift.yml-shaped dedicated workflow (the only pattern PROVEN to execute in CI). Decide must pick.
  • THROUGHPUT CORRECTION: 'parallel to the Elixir queue' is correctness-parallel, not wall-clock-parallel — elixir.yml has NO paths filter and runs on every PR; precedent PRs of this exact file class merged only after the Elixir suite finished (~13-16 min). Also: main has ZERO branch protection — every gate is discipline, not enforcement.

Coverage map — where surveyors looked

  • FOUND/settled: doctor.sh full text + all 4 commits of its history (merge-base never attempted before); Makefile cli targets + LDFLAGS; assets/embeds closure via go list; .claude/settings.json hook wiring; upgrade_test.go's assertions; local-update.sh control flow; scaffy/seed/main.go full read + live runs (green + DNS-mutation red); all 27-34 workflow files' triggers/paths; never-cancel-main-check.sh predicate; corpus_test.go census mechanics; branch-protection APIs (none); both anchor tasks' criteria; remote branches + open PRs (clean); worktree ref-sharing proven empirically incl. dangling objects.

Verify plan (in flight — last look before Decide)

Uncertainty-gated: four assignments, run-proofs mandatory where a claim is load-bearing. The flip-prone target is the doctor verdict matrix — legit up-to-date and ahead binaries MUST stay green.

  • vm-doctor-matrix (OPUS, run-proof): build fixture git repos and RUN the full verdict matrix for the GUARDED merge-base formula — at-tip green; behind-only RED; ahead-with-local-Go green; diverged RED; unknown BP_COMMIT loud skip; offline/missing-origin-ref loud skip (and PROVE the bare unguarded one-liner false-greens there, so the guard is demonstrably load-bearing); no-stamp red; identical verdicts from a non-main-branch worktree. Plus fixer-clears proof: rebuilt-at-tip binary flips red to green.
  • vm-upgrade-test-interplay (SONNET, worktree probe): edit doctor.sh to the guarded merge-base form in a throwaway worktree, RUN go test ./internal/cli/ -run TestDoctorReleaseCadence — prove the fake-git sandbox still exits 0 with the new git invocations; RUN doctor.sh --hook on a healthy checkout and prove stdout stays empty (hook silence contract).

Verification results (Decide, 2026-07-23)

Four verifiers ran; every load-bearing claim came back with run output. Trust order held: proofs over facts over prose.

  • vm-doctor-matrix PROVEN: guarded merge-base formula exact across all 8 cells on real fixture repos — "at-tip GREEN / behind-Go RED / behind-docs-only GREEN / ahead-local-Go GREEN / diverged RED / unknown SKIP / no-stamp RED"; non-main worktree identical. The guard is LOAD-BEARING: offline, the bare one-liner printed "BARE verdict: GREEN <-- FALSE-GREEN (behind binary reported healthy)" while the guarded form loud-skipped. Old-vs-new contrast: "OLD verdict: GREEN <-- FALSE-GREEN ... NEW verdict: RED(stale)" — the #5786-miss scenario reds honestly. Fixer-clears proven (cli-install rebuild flips RED to GREEN).
  • vm-upgrade-test-interplay RESOLVED with a coverage caveat: TestDoctorReleaseCadence passes before AND after the edit — but vacuously (its PATH has no fake bp, section 2 never runs; git.log showed zero cat-file/merge-base calls). With a fake bp added, merge-base hit the fixture fallthrough (empty stdout) and the guarded edit degraded to a LOUD skip, not a false ok. Full CC=clang go test ./internal/cli/... green (55.7s). TRAP for the harness: fake-git must stub merge-base and a fake bp must be on PATH, or the blind spot reproduces one level down.
  • vm-slice2-preflight ALL GREEN: draft scaffy-catalog-drift.yml passed never-cancel-main-check, check-doc-budgets, docs-anchors-check as-is; never-cancel MUTATION round-tripped (literal true → "FAIL scaffy-catalog-drift.yml", false → OK). seed --check mutation: one sed-mutated .scaffy → exit 1 with exactly "barkpark--migration--alter-add-index ... DRIFT", 21/22 MATCH; restore → 22/22 exit 0. Gap flagged: no in-CI self-test step in the draft — Decide adopted one (D7).
  • vm-vcs-grep-collision CLEAR: repo-wide, the ONLY go-version-m/vcs.revision/buildvcs hit is the charter doc line that REJECTS vcs stamps — zero code consumers, fence does not widen. Both anchor tasks re-verified open/unclaimed. cli-install-builder adjacency resolved: its task bl-cli-install-target is CLOSED (merged #5726/b0f1dcc19) — prior complementary groundwork, not a live collision; bug 1 confirmed still present post-#5726.
  • Coverage not-founds worth keeping: no scripts/doctor.test.sh exists anywhere (harness is genuinely new); no scripts/*.test.sh is wired to any CI workflow (the "ride an existing job" premise refuted); this real worktree is NOT healthy (3 pre-existing hook issues) so hook-silence was proven on a synthetic all-green fixture instead; Actions-runner egress to guerrilla is POST-MERGE-ONLY provable.

Decisions (Decide, 2026-07-23 — charter .claude/workflows/bp-cloud-epic-charter.md, D1-D11)

  • D1 merge-base semantics, not a bare origin/main swap — ahead-with-local-Go must stay green (proven, 8/8 cells).
  • D2 guard order cat-file → rev-parse --verify origin/main → merge-base → diff; failures route through bad()/skip(); unconditional exit 0 stays — the bare form false-greens offline (proven).
  • D3 pathspec gains deploy.sh — real binary input via cli-assets-sync; removes dependency on vendored-assets.yml staying enforced.
  • D4 permanent scripts/doctor.test.sh (install-cli.test.sh convention) + NEW shell-harnesses.yml CI lane — doctor.sh false-greened twice in one week; no existing lane runs any scripts/*.test.sh. Rejected: --selftest inside doctor.sh (checkout audits the binary).

Wave plan (in flight — 2 slices, both round 1, disjoint files)

  • SLICE 1 (medium, Opus, round 1, HIGH-FLIP-RISK: verdict matrix) — task scaffy-backlog-doctor-bp-freshness. doctor.sh guarded merge-base staleness fix + scripts/doctor.test.sh 8-cell harness + shell-harnesses.yml wiring. Files: scripts/doctor.sh, scripts/doctor.test.sh, .github/workflows/shell-harnesses.yml. Gate: bash -n scripts/doctor.sh && bash scripts/doctor.test.sh && bash scripts/never-cancel-main-check.sh && CC=clang go test ./internal/cli/ -run TestDoctorReleaseCadenceUsesPublishedStableRelease.

Files: .github/workflows/scaffy-catalog-drift.yml, Makefile. Gate: yaml-parse the workflow && bash scripts/never-cancel-main-check.sh && make seed-check.
  • BACKLOG FILED (published children of the epic): clirel-bl-local-update-early-exit (make update OLD==NEW early-exit skips bp rebuild), clirel-bl-go-tests-scaffy-paths (census path-filter blind spot, historic 7→12 incident), clirel-bl-wire-orphan-shell-tests (four orphaned scripts/*.test.sh into shell-harnesses.yml AFTER slice 1 merges).
  • Charter published to origin/main as 96eda225a (rotating slot; SPD occupant preserved in bp-studio-space-priority-charter.md). Both slice tasks re-published with build briefs, files labels, wave_paper=cli-reliability-wave-2026-07-23.

Debrief (Review, 2026-07-23 — wave closed)

SHIPPED — slice 1, task scaffy-backlog-doctor-bp-freshness, final branch loop-epic/doctor-sh-guarded-merge-base-staleness-f-0, PR #6023, ZERO reviewer fixes. doctor.sh section 2 implements D1-D3 exactly: RED iff Go inputs (incl. deploy.sh) changed over merge-base(BP_COMMIT, origin/main)..origin/main, behind the guarded ladder cat-file → rev-parse --verify --quiet origin/main (offline → LOUD skip) → non-empty merge-base → diff; advisory exit-0 tail, --hook silence, and the #5726 no-stamp red are preserved; the go-version-m unsoundness (D11) is recorded in a comment. The 8-cell doctor.test.sh harness runs on real bare-origin+clone fixtures with a fake bp on PATH (dodging the upgrade_test blind spot, D5) and is wired via the new shell-harnesses.yml lane. REVIEWER RE-DERIVATION of the HIGH-FLIP-RISK verdict matrix (E2): harness 8/8 green on the final branch; swapping in origin/main’s buggy doctor.sh under the same harness reds 6 cells, catching both genuine FALSE-GREENS behaviorally (cell 5 diverged and cell 8 offline both print “is current”); never-cancel guard mutation-proven (literal true → FAIL shell-harnesses.yml, restored → green). Honest caveat: under that mutation, cells 1/3/4 red on the ok-line WORDING change, not behavior — the behavioral catches are cells 5+8, as the builder disclosed. E2 flag stands: a genuinely independent second review of the matrix is warranted before merge.

SHIPPED — slice 2, task scaffy-backlog-seedcheck-ci-advisory, final branch loop-epic/scaffy-catalog-drift-yml-advisory-tokenl-1-r, PR #6025, ONE REAL REVIEWER FIX (cb88ac8c4). The builder’s step scripts captured exit codes as `out="$(cmd)"; code=$?` — but GitHub Actions’ default run shell is `bash -e {0}`, so errexit aborted the step BEFORE the capture: the self-test would have failed exactly when the tripwire correctly redded, and the audit step would have died before writing its DRIFT summary — the workflow’s entire purpose, silently dead on arrival in CI (the builder’s local simulation used plain bash, no -e, so it could not see this). Fixed to `code=0; out="$(cmd)" || code=$?` in both steps and proven end-to-end under `bash -e`: self-test exit 0 with a real DRIFT row against the live served catalog + clean restore; audit clean → exit 0 with in-sync summary; audit mutated → exit 1 with DRIFT-DETECTED summary. Also added `permissions: contents: read` (parity with shell-harnesses.yml, consistent with the TOKENLESS story). Everything else held as decided: advisory continue-on-error, literal-false cancel-in-progress (mutation-proven), tokenless, triage summary, read-only scaffy/seed, `make seed-check` (22/22 MATCH at review time).

LEDGER AUDIT: clean, zero fixes needed. Both slice tasks claimed by their builders, criteria stamped with real evidence as work progressed, lifecycle honestly in_progress with the merge criterion open for the lead (slice 1: criterion 5; slice 2: criterion 3). Three backlog children filed and published (clirel-bl-local-update-early-exit, clirel-bl-go-tests-scaffy-paths, clirel-bl-wire-orphan-shell-tests). No foreign tasks touched. One cosmetic staleness: slice 2’s claim now-line says “NOT pushed” — superseded by PR #6025 (the claim belongs to the builder’s worker, so the correction lives here and in the PR, not in an impersonated pulse).

GRADE: A-. Earned by: both wish bugs genuinely fixed with mutation proofs re-run independently by the reviewer, not just trusted; the doctor fix’s guard ladder and merge-base semantics are exactly the charter’s decided design with zero drift; the harness tests behavior on real git fixtures, not stubs; the wave stayed an honest 2 slices with premises re-confirmed live before building. Held back from A by: the slice-2 errexit bug — a shipped-as-green workflow whose self-test and drift summary could never function in the actual Actions shell, caught only at review; and the doctor harness’s coupling to exact ok/red wording, which makes future message edits red the harness (intended, but brittle against casual rewording). Not counted against the wave: dirty-at-tip binaries still green (out of scope by design — uncommitted content has no commit to diff).

NEXT WAVE: (1) lead merges #6023 (after the E2 independent second look at the verdict matrix) + #6025 + wave-log #6026; (2) lead discharges D10: one workflow_dispatch of scaffy-catalog-drift.yml on main proving Actions egress to guerrilla.barkpark.cloud, one live `make doctor` RED on a deliberately-behind worktree; (3) then the filed backlog in order: clirel-bl-wire-orphan-shell-tests (cheapest; unblocked once slice 1 lands), clirel-bl-go-tests-scaffy-paths (census-staleness path filter), clirel-bl-local-update-early-exit (fixer-side residual). No deferred round-2 slices existed — round 1 was the whole wave.
